text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It allows machines to read and analyse text, so they can find meaning in what people write. NLP is used in translation tools, which help us communicate across different languages. It also powers sentiment analysis, where computers decide whether a piece of text is positive, negative or neutral. This is useful for understanding customer opinions online. Another common use is chatbots, which answer questions and talk with users automatically. Thanks to NLP, technology is becoming better at communicating with people in a natural and helpful way.
